case.title: Which pending query preceded BEGIN failure and the stale transaction?
case.title_zh: BEGIN 失败并留下 stale transaction 前，是哪个查询占用了连接？

findings.observation: One asyncpg0.32.0/CPython3.14.3/private PostgreSQL17.1 run follows the original busy-query example: SELECT pg_sleep(0.5) occupies the Connection, so concurrent BEGIN raises InterfaceError. After the query finishes, the Connection is open and idle but _top_xact still points to that FAILED Transaction. The later transaction sends SAVEPOINT and raises native NoActiveSQLTransactionError, SQLSTATE25P01. Process exit0 and connection/server cleanup succeed. Selection/source/setup/run take115.05s.
findings.interpretation: The actual API-returned busy Task object0x73927aac5a90 independently matches the native pending Task snapshot and generic CoroPerf identity. The selected live sample precedes BEGIN failure; the same Task returns before the later SAVEPOINT error. CoroPerf joins creation2 to pending sample40 and recovers launch_busy_query, absent from the native Task stack and both error tracebacks. Additional API observations bind this Task, Connection0x73927aa75150 and failed Transaction0x73927a86e110 across the two failures. The source already describes stale _top_xact; the added diagnostic fact is the exact busy operation and its historical submission context.
findings.limits: This is the original concurrent-query/pre-send BEGIN component, not Aurora/RDS Proxy, SQLAlchemy, a pool or the cancelled-BEGIN variant. Original Task topology is retained: launch_busy_query only names the existing create_task expression, and the later transaction remains inline in main. Resource identity requires the explicit API observer; generic Task ancestry does not infer shared Connection/Transaction ownership. The native pending stack contains execute, and Python continuation inspection stops at the opaque Cython protocol awaiter. One successful scenario; no reset/fix, pool, proxy, cancellation variant, alternate version or additional batch.

case.symptom_zh: asyncpg0.32.0、CPython3.14.3、私有 PostgreSQL17.1 一次运行原始忙查询示例：SELECT pg_sleep(0.5) 占用连接，使并发 BEGIN 抛出 InterfaceError。查询结束后连接仍打开且服务端无事务，但 _top_xact 仍指向该 FAILED Transaction；后续事务发送 SAVEPOINT，得到原生 NoActiveSQLTransactionError、SQLSTATE25P01。进程退出0，连接和数据库清理完成。含选择、源码、准备和运行115.05秒。
case.reasoning_zh: API 实际返回的忙 Task 对象0x73927aac5a90 与独立的原生等待快照、Coroperf 身份一致。选取的活动采样早于 BEGIN 失败，同一任务在后续 SAVEPOINT 错误前正常返回。CoroPerf 把创建2接到等待采样40，恢复原生 Task 栈和两个错误回溯都缺失的 launch_busy_query。额外 API 观察把该任务、Connection0x73927aa75150 和失败 Transaction0x73927a86e110 关联到两次失败。报告已说明 stale _top_xact，新增诊断事实是实际占用连接的操作及其历史提交上下文。
case.limits_zh: 这是原始并发查询造成的发送前 BEGIN 失败组件，不是 Aurora/RDS Proxy、SQLAlchemy、pool 或取消 BEGIN 的变体。保持原始 Task 结构：launch_busy_query 只给既有 create_task 表达式命名，后续事务仍在 main 内直接执行。资源身份依赖额外 API 观察，不能从通用 Task 祖先关系推断共享 Connection/Transaction 所有权。原生等待栈仅有 execute，Python continuation 检查止于不透明的 Cython protocol awaiter。成功场景一次，没有 reset/修复、pool、proxy、取消变体、其他版本或额外批次。

limitations: This is the original concurrent-query/pre-send BEGIN component, not Aurora/RDS Proxy, SQLAlchemy, a pool or the cancelled-BEGIN comment variant.
The original Task topology is retained. launch_busy_query only names the existing create_task submission expression; the later transaction remains inline in main.
Generic Task capture recovers submission context. Explicit API observations supply shared Connection and failed Transaction identity; generic ancestry does not infer resource ownership.
The report already identifies the stale _top_xact cause. Added facts are the exact pending query Task, its historical submitter and its relation to the connection at failure.
The native pending Task snapshot contains only execute; the collector follows Python continuations up to the opaque Cython protocol awaiter, not native protocol internals.
One successful workload; no reset/fix, pool, proxy, cancelled-BEGIN, alternate version or extra query batch.
